data_dir.description: Path to the directory where reminders, state, and logs are stored

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to stderr

host.description: IP address the HTTP server binds to

port.description: Port number the HTTP server listens on

custom_templates.description: List of domain-specific email templates (for multi-tenant setups)

default: You have an event coming up:

subject_template_lines.description: Lines for the domain-specific subject template

uri.description: Database URI; use `sqlite:///path` for single-instance deployment

default: This is a reminder for your upcoming event:
default_body_lines.description: Lines in the default email body; supports Jinja2-style placeholders

default_subject.description: Default subject line for reminder emails

embed_images.description: Embed images in email body (not supported in baseline; placeholder)

basic_auth.description: Optional basic auth credentials (`user:pass`) for health endpoint access

enabled.description: Enable the `/healthz` endpoint (required for Kubernetes readiness/liveness probes)

file.description: Path to the log file (or '-' for stdout)

json.description: Emit logs in JSON format (for log aggregators)

lookahead_seconds.description: Time window (seconds) into the future to scan for reminders

scan_interval_seconds.description: How often to scan for upcoming reminders

timezone.description: Default timezone for reminder resolution (IANA tz database name)

from_address.description: Sender email address used as 'From' in all emails

password.description: SMTP auth password (stored in config file — secure with file permissions)

use_starttls.description: Explicitly request STARTTLS upgrade (use for port 587/25)

username.description: SMTP auth username (leave blank if unauthenticated)

throttle.description: Rate limiting per user to prevent abuse

burst_limit.description: Short burst limit (e.g., 10 emails in 2 minutes)

max_per_minute.description: Maximum number of emails a single user can trigger per minute

count.description: Number of concurrent background workers sending emails

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries per email on failure

timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) per SMTP connection and send operation
